name: Condemned Few MC
description: The Condemned Few MC is an outlaw motorcycle club founded in Queens, New York, with documented activity dating to at least 2008. The club claims orange, black, and white as its colors and uses a skeleton-on-motorcycle motif as its primary insignia. It has operated chapters in both Queens and Brooklyn.
